rootCause: Store resolution hierarchy had credentials.yaml (Level 2) shadowing canonical ~/.config/omnimux/secrets.json (Level 3), preventing CLI login updates from reaching App and causing 401 expiration traps; also stale New-Api-User headers during fetchSelf and uncoordinated config.json sync
fix: Elevated ~/.config/omnimux/secrets.json to highest storage priority in store.resolve/describe, synced config.json (user_id/base_url) on login/logout, removed stale New-Api-User headers from fetchSelf, and added bidirectional SSO test suite
